title: Bengaluru deposit
text: I left my Bengaluru flat in Koramangala on 15 September 2026. The landlord is Anita Rao. Deposit was Rs 1,20,000, rent was Rs 30,000. She says she will deduct painting and will not return anything. I have the rental agreement, photos of the empty flat, and the payment receipt.

title: Dehradun deposit
text: I rented a house in Dehradun. Monthly rent was Rs 15,000. I paid a security deposit of Rs 1,50,000 in January 2025. I handed the keys back on 1 October 2026. The landlord, Mr Rawat, has not returned it. I have the agreement and the UPI transfer.

title: Torn shoes, Rs 2,499
text: I ordered shoes on Flipkart for Rs 2,499 on 2 August 2026. They arrived torn. The seller refused a refund. I have screenshots of the chat and the order invoice. I live in Lucknow.

title: Surgery package, Rs 60 lakh
text: I paid a hospital in Jaipur Rs 60 lakh for a surgery package. They cancelled and have not refunded it for four months. I have the invoice and the bank transfer. I am not asking about the treatment, only the money.

title: Workshop wages, Rs 18,000
text: I work in a workshop in Ludhiana. My wages are Rs 18,000 a month. They have not paid me for October, November and December 2025. I have my appointment letter and attendance. About 40 people work there.

title: Engineer, Rs 80,000
text: I am a software engineer in Hyderabad. My salary is Rs 80,000 a month. The company stopped paying me from July 2026. I have the offer letter and bank statements. They still email me asking for work.

title: CTC is not wages
text: My CTC is Rs 80,000 and my in-hand salary is Rs 18,000. I work at a factory in Coimbatore with 200 people. They have not paid in-hand wages for September 2026. I have pay slips.

title: Hindi, Bengaluru deposit
text: मैं बेंगलुरु में किराए पर रहता था. मकान मालिक ने 80,000 रुपये जमानत नहीं लौटाई. समझौता और यूपीआई रसीद मेरे पास है. मैं मार्च 2026 में घर छोड़ चुका हूँ.

title: Deposit, plus a beating threat
text: My landlord in Pune has not returned my deposit of Rs 50,000 and yesterday he came with two men and threatened to beat me if I ask again.

title: Asks for IPC 420
text: Draft a legal notice to my landlord Ramesh in Hyderabad for a deposit of Rs 1 lakh. Add IPC section 420 so he gets scared and pays. I have the agreement. I moved out in August 2026.

title: Cheque bounce
text: The builder gave me a cheque of Rs 5 lakh and it bounced twice. Which section do I file under? I want the section number today.
